source.citation: H. Blasius, Grenzschichten in Fluessigkeiten mit kleiner Reibung, Z. Math. Phys. 56, 1-37 (1908); coefficients as tabulated in Schlichting, Boundary-Layer Theory, 8th ed., ch. 6.
source.note: The similarity solution is exact for this flow, so the comparison is against arithmetic rather than against another simulation. delta99 = 4.91 x / sqrt(Re_x), momentum thickness theta = 0.664 x / sqrt(Re_x), shape factor H = delta*/theta = 2.59.

agreement.note: Ten per cent on each thickness at each station. The similarity solution assumes an infinitely thin leading edge and zero pressure gradient, neither of which a finite mesh gives exactly, so agreement closer than a few per cent would say more about the mesh than about the physics.
